source.title: Call for Applicants - WMT Members (April 2020)
source.content:
The WCA Marketing Team (WMT) is seeking members to help in the following areas: 
- WCA Gear Team (US residents only)
- Graphic design for WCA merchandise and other projects (open for all graphic designers)
- Acquiring sponsorship and merchandising

The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered. 

**What does the WMT do?**
- Coordinates with Speed Stacks to manage and distribute WCA competition gear.
- Launches WCA merchandise in regions all over the world.
- Works on free downloadable templates for organisers and delegates that increase WCA's branding at competitions.
- Works on acquiring sponsorship for the WCA.
- Works and assists organisers around the world with sponsorships and maintaining the WCA brand in their region.

The official rights and duties of the WMT are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf).
<!-- break -->
**Characteristics we are looking for:**
- *Communication skills and email ethics*: You should be able to write a professional, concise email to answer delegate/client questions.
- *Patience*: You should keep friendly communications within our email and internal interactions.

**Requirements for WMT members in general:**
- Familiarity with marketing professionally or out of interest.
- Familiarity in dealing with merchandising/sponsorships/vendor management.
- Time commitment per week of 5-10 hours.
- FOR GRAPHICS APPLICANTS: Must be familiar with Adobe Illustrator or equivalent programs

**Platforms we communicate on:**
- Email for all official communication
- Slack for internal discussions
- Zoom/Hangouts for meetings 
- Trello for managing gear team orders

**Additional information for WMT Gear Team members:**
- Open for US residents only
- *Distribution of competition equipment is one of the most important tasks since we have to ensure that delegates around the world are well equipped with equipment for their competition.* Due to restrictions on international shipping, US members need to be willing to receive the package and repost it on behalf of the WMT Gear Team.
- Primary tasks involve receiving equipment orders, re-pack the equipment for international shipping, and make routine trips to the post office. 

Applications should be sent to Somya Srivastava ([ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org)) from now until **April 27, 2020, 23:59 UTC** to be considered.  

**The application must be in PDF format, and should include the following:**
- A brief personal introduction
- A description of any previous involvement with the WCA
- Motivation for applying to the WMT
- The specific team they would like to work in within the WMT

Anyone with questions about the positions or applying can contact Somya Srivastava ([ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org)).

Thank you for your interest and support!

translation.title: 招募 WCA 市场营销组成员（2020 年 4 月）
translation.content:
WCA 市场营销组（WMT）正在招募成员，协助以下工作：

- WCA 器材小组（仅限美国居民）。
- WCA 周边商品及其他项目的平面设计（面向所有平面设计师）。
- 争取赞助及开展周边商品业务。

所有 WCA 会员都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

**WMT 负责什么？**

- 与 Speed Stacks 协调，管理和分发 WCA 比赛器材。
- 在世界各地推出 WCA 周边商品。
- 为主办方和代表制作可免费下载的模板，加强比赛中的 WCA 品牌展示。
- 为 WCA 争取赞助。
- 协助各地主办方开展赞助工作，并维护当地的 WCA 品牌形象。

WMT 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 议案 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf)。

**我们希望申请者具备的素质：**

- *沟通能力与邮件礼仪：* 能写出专业、简洁的邮件，回答代表或客户的问题。
- *耐心：* 在邮件往来和内部交流中保持友好。

**WMT 成员的一般要求：**

- 因工作或个人兴趣而熟悉市场营销。
- 熟悉周边商品、赞助或供应商管理。
- 每周可投入 5–10 小时。
- 平面设计申请者：必须熟悉 Adobe Illustrator 或同类软件。

**我们使用的沟通平台：**

- 正式沟通使用电子邮件。
- 内部讨论使用 Slack。
- 会议使用 Zoom/Hangouts。
- 器材小组订单管理使用 Trello。

**WMT 器材小组成员的补充说明：**

- 仅限美国居民申请。
- *分发比赛器材是最重要的任务之一，因为我们要确保世界各地代表都有足够的器材用于比赛。* 由于国际运输的限制，美国成员需要愿意代 WMT 器材小组收取包裹并转寄。
- 主要工作包括处理器材订单、重新打包以便国际运输，以及定期前往邮局。

请于即日起至 **2020 年 4 月 27 日 23:59 UTC**，将申请发送给 Somya Srivastava（[ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料必须为 PDF 格式，并应包含：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 以往参与 WCA 的经历。
- 申请加入 WMT 的原因。
- 希望在 WMT 内具体从事哪一组工作。

如对职位或申请有疑问，可联系 Somya Srivastava（[ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

感谢大家的关注与支持！
